prompt: Vera counts stars from the rooftop
title: Silver Rooftop Stars
irony: Vera counts stars to pin each one down, yet the count only grows while she misses the sky, so she trades counting for dancing and the rooftop turns sleepy under uncounted light.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Teddy and Benny lie on the warm rooftop rug under thick night stars.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy opens a star book on the rooftop while Vera lines up charts and Benny points at the bright sky.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Knox climbs up and dares Teddy to count ten stars before the porch light blinks.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Teddy, Benny, Knox and Vera sing the rooftop stars chant under the wide night sky.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Teddy counts aloud, Knox shouts wrong numbers, and Benny mixes clouds with stars.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Vera drops charts in the wind and Teddy tumbles into pillows while Knox laughs.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Teddy, Benny, Knox and Vera repeat the rooftop stars chant as clouds cross the moon.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Vera holds her quiet chart and sees she misses the sky while counting.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Vera drops the chart, lifts Benny up, and chooses a slow dance under stars.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Teddy, Benny, Knox and Vera sing the chant while Vera turns the last line into dance.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Teddy, Benny and Vera hum softly on pillows under uncounted stars after the dance.
